name: Fujibayashi Sakuya
source:
"Shadows do not need emotions."

Sakuya, who grew up together with you in the village of Iga. When he appears before you again as Nobunaga's shinobi, he has cold eyes that are different from those in your memories.

Temperament: Service-oriented
Familiar: Tobimaru
